part.text:
The robot is at the end of the corridor, in front of the green panel, and I've called rest. It's now crouched with its motors off.

The corridor ran straight for about 4 m, then turned left, then ran about 3 m more to the panel. A collision-protection stop ended the last walk just short of the panel. The camera showed the panel filling the view.

The robot isn't square to the panel. It's turned about 8° off to one side, and the odometry heading shifted slightly while it crouched.
